name: Irvin Thevaranjan
headline: Technology Risk Leader | Internal Audit | Community Builder
hook: Technology risk leader, auditor, accidental community builder, and the person whose layoff spreadsheet got seriously out of hand.
summary: Professionally, Irvin works across technology risk, internal audit, SOX, governance, and controls. After the Grubhub layoffs, a spreadsheet of people looking for work became a larger experiment in visibility, introductions, job-search tools, and community-driven hiring. The through-line: reduce noise, increase signal, and make it easier for the right people to find one another.
